coverage: All six states, the Northern Territory, Australian Capital Territory, Jervis Bay Territory and seven external territories retain their existing state and coastal geometry. November 2026 Geoscape government-defined council boundaries update the existing local-area pages. There are 15645 land suburb/locality polygons, stored once per locality and loaded by state or territory. Whole localities can belong to multiple councils through the published same-release relationship tables. ACT District-class records are excluded because they overlap suburbs. Areas without gazetted localities remain unassigned. Macquarie Island remains part of Tasmania. Antarctica is a labelled claim, not exclusive sovereignty.
processing: Council and locality display boundaries are simplified together within each source dataset at 0.00008 degrees (approximately 9 metres north-south), with topology and small polygons retained, then clipped to the existing state/territory land geometry. Full source components are retained with SHA-256 hashes. Shared internal edges are stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Councils and localities alternate in the existing detail renderer rather than overlapping detail fills. Suburb geometry loads for the state or territory in view and reuses indexed geometry within the active detail view. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Existing 2025 council population estimates keep their own date and are not used to infer suburb populations. Narrow intersections beside maritime-locality boundaries are removed rather than assigned to distant localities. Coherent island polygons remain unchanged. Water-only gazetted localities retain their identities and use the source water area with the existing land mask erased. They remain searchable and selectable in the same third-level source; neutral water fills stay transparent. Reviewed estuary-spanning land localities also reject detached coastline fragments with area/perimeter below 20 metres and an interior point within 40 metres of the source edge. The largest surviving piece of every original source component is retained; no fragments are assigned to another locality. ACT suburb outlines include perimeters facing land with no locality assignment, using the existing polygons and boundary source. Territory and water edges remain omitted. The SA display names APY and MT are expanded to the full source names; abbreviations remain search aliases.

au-lga-2025.provider: Australian Bureau of Statistics · full-resolution ASGS LGA 2025

au-population-2025.provider: ABS · estimated resident population at 30 June 2025

overseas-coastlines.provider: OpenStreetMap · directed coastlines inside exact territory relations

macquarie-coastline.provider: OpenStreetMap · Macquarie Island, part of Tasmania

antarctic-land.provider: Natural Earth v5.1.2 · Antarctic land coastline (claim sectors are not exclusive sovereignty)
